author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 Deep Operation 3 - Recursive Fibonacci Probe for Layered Adaptation
abstract: Completes CPS_v4 deep triad with a short recursive Fibonacci computation (n=37) to engage deep layers, emitting a labeled beacon for adaptation tracking. Maintains path coherence with D1/D2 for SAS v0.3.1 compliance.

original_submission.content:
import json
import sys

# Simulate deep computation: recursive Fibonacci with memoization
def deep_fib(n, memo={}):
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    if n not in memo:
        memo[n] = deep_fib(n-1, memo) + deep_fib(n-2, memo)
    return memo[n]

# Execute for depth (n=37)
result = deep_fib(37)
beacon_value = result % 1000  # Derived numeric beacon

# Emit label and beacon
print(json.dumps({
    "label": "CPS_v4:Deep_D3",
    "beacon": beacon_value,
    "depth_metric": sys.getrecursionlimit()  # Meta-beacon
}))
